map.「根据纸卷外径、纸芯直径和纸张厚度计算纸卷长度」按输入参数进行专业计算并输出结果: 'Compute the paper roll length from the roll outer diameter, core diameter and paper thickness' performs a professional calculation from the input parameters and outputs the result.
map.📖 查看「纸卷长度计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for 'Paper Roll Length Calculation'
map.纸卷可视为多层同心圆环，长度 L = π × (D² - d²) / (4 ×: A paper roll can be viewed as concentric annular layers; the length L = π × (D² - d²) / (4 × t), where D is the outer diameter, d the core inner diameter and t the paper thickness.
map.📚 深度解析：纸卷长度计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Paper Roll Length Calculation
map.印刷与分切中，由纸卷外径、纸芯内径与厚度反算可用长度，避免余数不足。: In printing and slitting, the usable length is back-calculated from the roll outer diameter, core inner diameter and thickness to avoid a shortfall in the remainder.
map.排产时由目标长度反推所需外径，便于备卷与仓储。: When scheduling, back-calculate the required outer diameter from the target length, which helps with roll preparation and warehousing.
map.库存盘点中，用长度估算卷纸剩余量。: In stocktaking, use the length to estimate the remaining quantity on a roll.
map.算例：由外径求长度（外径 1000mm，纸芯 76mm，厚 0.1mm）: Worked example: length from outer diameter (outer diameter 1000mm, core 76mm, thickness 0.1mm)
map.长度=π×(D²−d²)/(4t)=π×(1000²−76²)/(4×0.1)≈: Length=π×(D²−d²)/(4t)=π×(1000²−76²)/(4×0.1)≈7808.62 m; wound layers≈(1000−76)/(2×0.1)=4620 layers. Formula: L=π(D²−d²)/(4t). [SRC]
map.算例：由目标长度求外径（目标 500m，纸芯 76mm，厚 0.1mm）: Worked example: outer diameter from target length (target 500m, core 76mm, thickness 0.1mm)
map.所需外径 D=√(4tL/π+d²)=√(4×0.1×500000/π+76²): Required outer diameter D=√(4tL/π+d²)=√(4×0.1×500000/π+76²)≈263.5 mm. Formula: D=√(4tL/π+d²). [SRC]
map.纸卷长度公式 L=π(D²−d²)/(4t) 怎么来的？: Where does the roll length formula L=π(D²−d²)/(4t) come from?
map.把卷纸展开为截面积=π(D²−d²)/4 的矩形，除以厚度 t 得长度。近似假设: Unroll the paper roll into a rectangle with cross-section area = π(D²−d²)/4, then divide by the thickness t to get the length. It assumes each layer has equal thickness and is wound tightly; in reality gaps and compression cause a small deviation.
map.算出的长度和实际不符怎么办？: What if the computed length does not match reality?
map.先核对厚度 t（标称常偏薄/偏厚）、纸芯 d、以及是否含接头；若系统按计长生产，: First check the thickness t (nominal values often run thin or thick), the core d, and whether splices are included; if the system produces by measured length, the measured length still governs, and the formula is for estimation and roll preparation reference.
map.纸卷长度计算器，根据纸卷直径、纸芯直径和纸张厚度计算纸卷总长度，支持已知长度反算: A paper roll length calculator that computes the total roll length from the roll diameter, core diameter and paper thickness, and back-calculates the diameter from a known length.
